visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Average Loses Its Decimals
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The average of 7, 8 and 8 should print 7.67, but the program prints 7.00.

solution.explanation: sum / n is an integer division (23 / 3 = 7), so the .67 is already gone when the result is converted to double. Convert one operand to double before dividing: (double)sum / n.
